revisions.note_on_followup_commit: Follow-up commit changes 0 English verse-text wording strings (4 verses restored verbatim from unplaced to verses + 12 mapping/seam notes added/refined + 1 false unplaced note removed).

strict_honesty_policy: ONLY individually documented verses or explicitly named verse/chapter ranges in surviving files are counted as documented_contextual_read. Aggregate-only claims without surviving chapter/verse IDs ('155 OT chapters', '158/163 NT chapters / 4,839 NT verses', deleted helper_*_notes.md, Claude's unlogged prose claim, and 351 automated global consistency batch rows) are excluded and reported separately under unattributed_aggregate_claims / automated_screening_only.

editorial_status_separate_from_coverage.note: Editorial status reflects open/resolved disputes and human-queue escalations across all 34,198 verses; it is strictly distinct from whether a verse has a surviving documented contextual read.

unattributed_aggregate_claims.claim_text: Method #3 claims 'Every verse and note was read against its Greek' across all 70 books / 34,150 verses.
unattributed_aggregate_claims.why_unattributed: No per-verse reading log exists for the ~32,700 unedited verses; only the 1,819 rows in wording-changes.jsonl and explicitly named passages/3 zero-change books in README.md are individually evidenced. Additionally, 351 automated global/edition-wide batch consistency rows in wording-changes.jsonl (NT-wide, OT-wide, Pentateuch-wide, Psalter-wide, 1-2 Kings regnal formula, edition-wide lowercase, house-style notes, missed-by-formula-pass) are excluded from documented_contextual_read and classified strictly as automated_screening_only.

unattributed_aggregate_claims.claim_text: 155 OT chapters read in context (per-book integer context_chapters_read across 43 OT books).
unattributed_aggregate_claims.why_unattributed: Underlying helper_ot_notes.md was deleted before commit and does not exist in git history; pass1_coverage.json records only per-book integer counts without naming which chapters/verses were read. Even the 3 OT books where context_chapters_read == chapters (Esther 10/10, Song of Songs 8/8, Jonah 4/4 = 329 verses) are conservatively left unassigned here because no surviving chapter/verse reading log exists.

unattributed_aggregate_claims.claim_text: 158 NT chapters / 4,839 NT verses read in context (board #61 assigned 160 chapters; board #69 claimed 163 chapters).
unattributed_aggregate_claims.why_unattributed: Underlying helper_nt_notes.md was deleted before commit and does not exist in git history; exact chapter/verse IDs do not survive, and the aggregate chapter count is internally inconsistent across pass1_coverage.json (158), #61 (160), and #69 (163). Even the 17 short NT epistles where context_chapters_read == chapters (1,594 verses) are conservatively left unassigned here because no surviving chapter/verse reading log exists.
